modality_evidence.evidence: The official page lists two 3D lidars, two time-synchronized cameras, one mmWave radar, and four audio array nodes.
The paper states that each sequence contains visual, 4x audio, 2x LIDAR, and RADAR data; its comparison table marks RF as not included.

evidence.evidence: The V1 download table lists Mavic2 14.1 GB / 198 s, Mavic3 11.1 GB / 321.1 s, Phantom4 13.2 GB / 181.4 s, Avata 19.7 GB / 396.3 s, and M300 14.4 GB / 428.7 s. V2/V3 rows show unknown size/duration.
The paper states that over 1700 seconds of multimodal rosbag data were divided into 50 sequences with a 60/20/20 train/test/validation allocation.

Radar: pcd for extracted point clouds not separately confirmed as radar-only

evidence.evidence: The paper describes rosbag format and filesystem format. Filesystem extraction saves images as PNG, audio as 1-second numpy segments, point clouds as PCD, and 3D position data in python-numpy files.
The download table provides ROSBag Data, Folder Data .zip, and Ground truth .bag entries.
The paper lists drone groups, 2D object detection benchmarks, 3D position estimation, timestamps, ROS topics, and Leica ground truth alignment.
The challenge page uses MMAUD data for UAV tracking and pose estimation and lists training/validation sequence counts and UAV types.

evidence.evidence: Sensor setup and Table II list the camera, LiDAR, audio, radar, ROS topics/message types, and rates. The ground-truth section states Leica locations are recorded at 5 Hz.
The official page summarizes the sensor suite and provides CAD/calibration resources.

notes: STRONG is assigned at source level because the official sources provide ROS timestamps, sequence organization, calibration assets, and Leica/image timestamp alignment.
The paper also reports sensor synchronization limitations and ground-truth gaps, so sample-level synchronization remains NOT_TESTED until data is inspected.

evidence.evidence: The paper states ROS messages carry header.stamp timestamps, Leica timestamps are used to align images with ground truth, and sensor calibration methods are provided. It also states synchronization remains challenging.
The official page provides calibration data links and ROSBag/folder data downloads.

notes: All unconfirmed fields are marked UNKNOWN.
Full name is marked CONFLICT because the official page heading and ICRA/arXiv paper title differ.
V2/V3 rows on the official download table expose links but not sizes/durations in page text.
Validation was performed on UG2+ derived validation subset, not the full MMAUD dataset.

The subset supports cross-modal indexing by sequence_id plus timestamp, but final status is PARTIALLY_VERIFIED because Audio, calibration files, ground truth/reference CSV, and complete V1/V2/V3 coverage remain incomplete.

validated_subset.note: This validates an official-related UG2+ derived validation subset, not the full MMAUD V1/V2/V3 dataset.

notes: Timestamp association supports a sequence_id + timestamp cross-modal index.
LIKELY_SYNCHRONIZED is not the same as SYNCHRONIZED_CONFIRMED.
Do not assume each camera frame has a unique perfectly simultaneous Radar/LiDAR frame.

modality_validation.notes: PNG camera files are present in all 16 validated sequences; sampled PNG readability passed; filename timestamps support nearest-neighbor matching.
Audio is documented in official MMAUD but is not present in the current val.zip derived validation subset.
radar_enhance_pcl NPY files are present; sampled readability passed; Camera-to-Radar median nearest-timestamp delta is 17.367 ms.
lidar_360 NPY files are present; sampled readability passed; Camera-to-LiDAR360 median nearest-timestamp delta is 20.182 ms.
livox_avia NPY files are present; sampled readability passed; Camera-to-Livox median nearest-timestamp delta is 18.995 ms.
Official MMAUD and UG2+ references mention Leica/pose/ground truth, but the downloaded val.zip input subset did not include ground_truth or pose/reference CSV files.
Official paper comparison/source audit indicates RF/IQ is not included.
Thermal/IR is not listed in official sensors and was not found in the validated subset.

format_validation.notes: 2,426 .png camera files; sampled images read as 2560x960 RGB PNG.
2,818 .npy files across lidar_360, livox_avia, and radar_enhance_pcl; sampled NPY arrays were readable.
val/seq0001..seq0016 with Image, lidar_360, livox_avia, radar_enhance_pcl.
All inspected modality filenames parse as numeric timestamp stems.
Documented for official full MMAUD, but no ROSBag was read in this val.zip subset.
Documented for full filesystem exports, but current val.zip confirmed NPY point-cloud-like arrays, not PCD files.

label_ground_truth_validation.notes: MMAUD_2D.zip was not downloaded; current val.zip contains sensor inputs, not 2D labels.
No ground_truth directory or Leica/pose file was found in the validated val.zip subset.
No local UG2+ reference/pose CSV matching this val subset was available during final validation.
All camera, lidar_360, livox_avia, and radar filenames parsed as numeric timestamps.
16 sequence directories were confirmed: seq0001 through seq0016.
Official sources document drone models, but the current subset did not expose per-file drone model labels.
Official sources document environment categories, but the current subset did not expose per-sequence environment labels.

limitations: The validated data is a UG2+ derived validation subset, not the complete MMAUD V1/V2/V3 dataset.
Audio is documented by official MMAUD sources but was not present in the downloaded val.zip subset and remains NOT_TESTED.
Calibration/reference support is PARTIAL: official/source-level calibration resources are documented, but no local calibration matrices or transforms were validated inside val.zip.
Cross-modal validation is based on sequence_id plus nearest-neighbor timestamp matching, not strict hardware-level synchronization.
Sensor rates differ across modalities, so one-to-one frame correspondence must not be assumed.
Ground truth, pose/reference CSV, and 2D annotations were not validated in the downloaded val.zip subset.
Complete V1/V2/V3 packages were not exhaustively downloaded or validated.
Dataset/work license is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so commercial use is not allowed by default.
advantages: Official page, paper, repository, challenge page, and license evidence are available.
Validated real subset contains Camera, Radar, LiDAR360, and Livox Avia data in a clear sequence structure.
PNG and NPY files were actually read in samples, not only documented.
Timestamp-style filenames are parseable across all validated modalities.
Nearest-timestamp matching produced practical median deltas: 20.182 ms Camera-LiDAR360, 18.995 ms Camera-Livox, and 17.367 ms Camera-Radar.
A sequence_id + timestamp cross-modal index is technically feasible for knowledge-management and retrieval experiments.
recommended_uses: Cross-modal indexing using sequence_id plus timestamp metadata
Future embedding experiments after an explicit downstream embedding stage
not_proven_uses: Image-to-Audio retrieval, because Audio was not present in the validated subset.
Ground-truth pose evaluation, because local pose/reference CSV or ground_truth files were not validated.
Strict hardware synchronization claims, because current validation supports likely timestamp association rather than confirmed hardware sync.
